sentences.text:
This appeal under Section 173(1) of the Indian Motor Vehicles Act is filed against the judgment and award dated 04.10.2017 passed by the III Additional Senior Civil Judge and VII Additional MACT,
at Davangere in MVC No.619/2015.
2.

III Additional Senior Civil Judge and VII Additional MACT,
at Davangere
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appellants/claimants filed a claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1989 claiming just and proper compensation for the death of Thippeswamy.
The trial Court in all granted total compensation of Rs.8,45,000/-with interest at the rate of 8% interest per annum.
Claimants are in appeal seeking enhancement of compensation.

3. Heard the learned counsel for appellant and learned counsel for the respondent.
4.
The death of Thippeswamy in a road traffic accident on 27.11.2014 is not disputed, and as on the date of the accident, the deceased was aged about 48 years.

In the absence of proof of income the notional income of the deceased is assessed at 8,000/- as per the chart issued by the Karnataka legal Aid Services Authority as against Rs.5000/- assessed by the Tribunal.
After adding 25% towards loss of future prospects and deducting 1/4th towards personal expenses the income of the deceased is assessed at Rs.10,625/-.

Therefore, the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is reassessed as follows:
NC: 2024:KHC:21152

Loss of dependency : Rs.11,47,500/-
Loss of Estate and funeral expenses : Rs.30,000/-
5.
Compensation amount awarded under other heads is just and proper and remains unaltered.

6. The appellants/claimants are entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.6,07,500/-
with interest at the rate of 6% per annum in addition to Rs.8,45,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.
To this extent the impugned award stands modified.
7. Enhanced compensation amount of Rs.6,07,500/- with interest to be deposited by the respondent - Insurance Company within three months from the date of receipt of the certified copy.
8. Pending I.A's does not survive for consideration.
